slide.name: Slide
slide.text: Solves problems through deception and influence; people are tools.
slide.xpTrigger: Gain xp when you address a challenge with deception or social manipulation.
list: What are they about to do?
How can I get them to [X]?
What do they really care about?
How can I blend in here?

rooks-gambit.name: Rook's Gambit
rooks-gambit.text: For 2 stress, use your best action rating instead of another, describing how.

mesmerism.name: Mesmerism
mesmerism.text: The target forgets your conversation until you next meet, noticing no gap in memory.

trust-in-me.name: Trust in Me
trust-in-me.text: +1d to any action against someone you have a close relationship with.

subterfuge.name: Subterfuge
subterfuge.text: Special armor: resist consequences of suspicion and negotiation, or push yourself when deceiving for free.

like-looking-into-a-mirror.name: Like Looking into a Mirror
like-looking-into-a-mirror.text: You always know whether you are being lied to or told the truth.

cloak-and-dagger.name: Cloak & Dagger
cloak-and-dagger.text: +1d when in disguise to avoid suspicion and deceive; dropping the disguise gives surprise.

ghost-voice.name: Ghost Voice
ghost-voice.text: You can speak with ghosts and demons as with people; potency when dealing with the supernatural.

a-little-something-on-the-side.name: A Little Something on the Side
a-little-something-on-the-side.text: At the end of each downtime, +2 coin to your stash.

fine-clothes-and-jewelry.name: Fine Clothes & Jewelry
fine-clothes-and-jewelry.text: Lets you pass as an aristocrat; load 2 if carried to change into.

fine-disguise-kit.name: Fine Disguise Kit
fine-disguise-kit.text: Improves the effect of deception and disguise.

fine-loaded-dice-and-trick-cards.name: Fine Loaded Dice, Trick Cards
fine-loaded-dice-and-trick-cards.text: Influence chance and improve the effect of cheating.

slide-trance-powder.name: Trance Powder
slide-trance-powder.text: A drug: the user is sluggish and suggestible, almost as if hypnotized.

cane-sword.name: Cane Sword
cane-sword.text: A blade hidden in a cane, invisible at a glance.

bryl.name: Bryl
bryl.text: A reliable contact, or an old partner with a grudge.

bazso-baz.name: Bazso Baz
bazso-baz.text: An admirer, or a despised former lover.

nyryx.name: Nyryx
nyryx.text: An informant on suitable marks, or a rival swindler.

harker.name: Harker
harker.text: A friend who helped you in prison, or an enemy who harmed you there.

slide-heartbreaker.name: Heartbreaker
slide-heartbreaker.text: Consort +1, Prowl +1, Attune +2. Trust in Me.

slide-swindler.name: Swindler
slide-swindler.text: Study +1, Consort +1, Finesse +2. A Little Something on the Side.
